subject: Renewal: support & SLA options for StormScale account
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@stormscale.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal: support & SLA options for StormScale account

Hi Neha,

Hope you're well — our renewal is coming up in late July and the exec team wants to explore moving to a higher support tier and locking down latency SLOs. We're seeing a steady increase in peak traffic and want to avoid tail-latency incidents during Black Friday prep. Key asks from my side: 1) premium support (faster response + named oncall), 2) a latency SLO (95th percentile target), and 3) a modest committed capacity increase with burst headroom.

Can you share a recommended package and an estimate of the incremental cost? Also, we have a procurement lead (Ethan Miller) who will need contract language for an SLA addendum.

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Platform, StormScale
agomez@stormscale.com

--
Attachment: traffic-peaks-Q2.csv (csv, referenced)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@stormscale.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: support & SLA options for StormScale account

Hi Alicia — great timing and thanks for the clear ask. High level proposal below; I'm happy to jump on a quick call to walk through numbers.

Proposed package (renewal add-on):
- Premium SLA: 30 min P1 response, named on-call roster, monthly incident review with CS/Eng
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile token latency target of 150ms for standard gen workloads (seq len distribution to be validated against your traffic)
- Capacity: +20% committed capacity year-over-year, with a 30% burst pool available for spikes (billed as overage credits when used)
- Optional: 24x7 technical coverage upgrade for on-call handoffs (additive item)

Estimated incremental cost: one-time amendment + 18% on top of current committed run-rate (detailed pricing attached). We can tier the discount if you commit to a 12- or 24-month term.

Next steps I suggest: 1) Ben to share a draft SLA addendum we can put into DocuSign, 2) Marissa to confirm pricing/credit math and prepare MAAP (monthly average API profile) worksheet, 3) schedule a 30-min decision call with your procurement + SREs.

Looping Ben and Marissa. When's good for you next week?

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: preliminary-pricing-stormscale.xlsx (spreadsheet, referenced)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Alicia Gomez <agomez@stormscale.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T14:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: support & SLA options for StormScale account

Quick pricing note / internal draft.

Neha — based on the +20% committed capacity and the premium SLA, here's a clean approach:
- 12-month term: list uplift 18%, Redwood partner discount applied => net uplift ~14%
- 24-month term: commit discount reduces net uplift to ~10% plus one-off onboarding credit to help smooth the first-month cost

On credits/overage: propose 200k token credit bucket for the first quarter as a goodwill buffer while you ramp into the burst pool. If StormScale wants to preserve unused credits, we can allow a single-quarter rollover to the following quarter (contract clause).

I'll attach an SLA addendum draft for Neha/Marissa to review before we send to procurement.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Solutions (Redwood)

Subject: Re: Renewal: support & SLA options for StormScale account

Thanks Ben & Neha — this looks very reasonable. A couple of procurement items from our side before we sign: 1) we need precise failure & remedy language for the latency SLO (how credits are computed), 2) a single point of contact for incident escalation, and 3) confirmation that the burst pool usage will consume credits before billing overage.

Ethan (cc) — can you confirm if StormScale legal needs any special wording for the remedy calculation? If not, we'll review the addendum and aim to sign in the next 10 business days.

Alicia

Subject: Re: Renewal: support & SLA options for StormScale account

Hi Alicia / Ethan — jumping in to confirm operational and legal-friendly language. Attached is SLA_Addendum_v2.pdf which includes:
- Clear measurement window and method (95th pctl measured across production gen endpoints, 30-day lookback)
- Remedy calculation: pro-rated service credit equal to (SLO shortfall %) * monthly committed spend, with a floor and cap to prevent outsized exposures
- Burst pool: consumption order is credits -> burst pool -> overage billing; we included explicit examples in Appendix B.

DocuSign link is ready once you confirm the term length (12 vs 24 months) and the rollover credit preference. I also uploaded an MAAP workbook (StormScale_MAAP_Updated.xlsx) with token distribution and seq length breakdown — please validate the traffic assumptions so we can finalize the latency target.

DocuSign: https://na1.app.docusign.com/Envelope/ABC123DEF456
Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/teams/renewals/StormScale/MAAP

If you approve, we'll issue the final addendum and route to Ethan's procurement for signature.
